digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and complexity baseline gate
propositions: CI has no lock preventing changes to .github/complexity-baseline.json, unlike the module-size limit which is locked against main
The baseline can grow by adding new entries because the test only checks schema, sortedness, and entry count parity with live functions, not that the entry count is monotonically non-increasing
The module-size limit lock fails open with a warning when git fetch of main fails, allowing unverified limit values from the current branch to be used
A semantic lock must distinguish legitimate shrinkage (removed or lowered entries) from illegitimate growth (raised or added entries)
Adding a new high-complexity function with a matching baseline entry in the same change currently passes CI despite exceeding the C901 threshold
